youtube.baslik: How does a test box reveal a hearing aid fault? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Test box measurement is the first tool to turn to not only at delivery, but also when the user reports a problem. Gain lower than expected often points to a receiver or microphone inlet blocked with debris, and increased distortion suggests a weak battery or a damaged receiver; high battery current may explain the complaint that batteries run down quickly.
